title: Adapt center column from session chat to project conversation

summary.goal: Adapt the center column from session chat to project conversation with system events, context markers, and relay integration.

acceptance_criteria.description: ChatInput renamed to ConversationInput, ChatMessageList to ConversationMessages
SystemEvent component renders compact inline markers (e.g., '┊ Step completed · 4m 12s · PR #43 created') at attention level 1
ContextMarker component renders subtle dividers when conversation focus shifts
RelayProvider (copied from planner-ui) wraps the app, provides shared WebSocket connection
FocusMode stays for forming block inspection
Conversation renders both user/AI messages and system events in chronological order

observations: The center column keeps most of ideation-ui's chat infrastructure.
Key additions: SystemEvent (new, inspired by planner-ui MessageStream inline events), ContextMarker (new), and relay WebSocket integration (copy RelayProvider + useRelayConnection from planner-ui).
The conversation is one continuous thread per project.

steps.title: Rename chat components to conversation naming
steps.description: Rename packages/tend/src/components/chat/SessionChatView.tsx → ConversationPane.tsx. Rename ChatInput.tsx → ConversationInput.tsx. Rename ChatMessageList.tsx → ConversationMessages.tsx. Update all imports across packages/tend/.

steps.title: Create SystemEvent component for inline markers
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/conversation/SystemEvent.tsx. Render compact inline format: '┊ Step completed · 4m 12s · PR #43 created'. Use attention level 1 styling (lower font weight, blends in). Clickable to open relevant context (agent tab or tree node).

steps.title: Create ContextMarker component for focus shifts
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/conversation/ContextMarker.tsx. Render subtle divider when conversation focus shifts (e.g., from dashboard to project, or between tree scopes). Minimal styling, fades into background.

steps.title: Copy RelayProvider and useRelayConnection from planner-ui
steps.description: Copy packages/planner-ui/src/contexts/RelayContext.tsx → packages/tend/src/contexts/RelayContext.tsx. Copy packages/planner-ui/src/hooks/useRelayConnection.ts → packages/tend/src/hooks/useRelayConnection.ts. Wire WebSocket connection in App.tsx. Update relay channel IDs to project-scoped (#project-{id}).

steps.title: Update ConversationMessages to render system events and markers
steps.description: In ConversationMessages: update message rendering to support ProjectMessage interface (role, content, metadata). Render user/AI messages (ChatBubble), system events (SystemEvent), and context markers (ContextMarker) chronologically. Sort by created_at. Keep FocusMode, TypingIndicator.
